test_item:
DebugAuth shall check SAM certificate as part of AuthData verification.
(SAM certificate does not anchor to the OEM issued root; verification fails)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderAndroidInstrumentalTest.apk is installed
3. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. An AuthData package is available on a USB drive
proc:
1. Read the SAM certificate format and subject on the host
$ openssl x509 -in SAMcert.pem -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. <DUT-side trigger for SAM AuthData with a non-anchoring certificate provided by RD (X-g)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-g)>
er:
1. The openssl x509 output shows an "Issuer:" line that does not anchor to the OEM issued root certificate
2. The openssl command prints "unable to get issuer certificate" on stdout
3. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
